verdict.rationale: Mistral's API reference documents a "List Models" endpoint (`GET /v1/models`) and a "Retrieve Model" endpoint, so an agent can enumerate the catalog programmatically, and the official Python and TypeScript SDKs give it a client to call them. The model-lifecycle docs describe stages from release to retirement, which adds context for working with that catalog. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the endpoint returns the live catalog, and documentation of response fields (e.g. capabilities, lifecycle or deprecation status)
